Recover CAS objects that have index entries but missing files.

This command helps fix CAS index inconsistencies where:
  - Objects exist in the CAS index but their hash files are missing
  - Objects can be recovered from ID-based files (if they exist)
  - Stale index entries need to be cleaned up

Examples:
  # Recover a specific object
  zqk system recover-cas AAM-009

  # Recover all objects of a kind
  zqk system recover-cas --kind command_metric

  # Recover without removing from index (only recreate)
  zqk system recover-cas --kind command_metric --no-remove-from-index

  # Only remove from index, don't try to recreate
  zqk system recover-cas --kind command_metric --no-recreate-from-id

Usage:
  zqk system recover-cas [object-id...] [flags]

Flags:
      --kind string         Recover all objects of this kind
      --recreate-from-id    Attempt to recreate files from ID-based files if they exist (default true)
      --remove-from-index   Remove objects from index if file is missing and can't be recovered (default true)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
